youtube_title: Bẫy Giá Mồi: Vì Sao Bạn Luôn Chọn Cỡ Lớn?

thumbnail_spec.visual_hook: Macro 35mm vertical 9:16 shot of three coffee cups with price labels under warm directional tungsten keylight
thumbnail_spec.prompt: Cinematic documentary vertical 9:16 tabletop photograph of three glass cups of iced coffee arranged by small, medium, and large sizes on a dark textured slate table, bold uppercase text 'BẪY GIÁ MỒI' visible on coffee sleeve, warm directional tungsten keylight, crisp polymer VND currency notes, f/2.0 shallow depth of field, 8k documentary still, zero graphic overlay cards, no cartoons.

cta_plan.bridge: Bản phân tích đầy đủ năm bẫy giá ẩn đang có trên video dài của kênh.
cta_plan.close: Hãy kiểm tra lại hóa đơn gần nhất để giữ chặt túi tiền của bạn.

beats.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 documentary photograph of an adult customer hand picking up a tall glass cup of iced Vietnamese milk coffee from a dark textured slate counter, condensation drops running down glass, warm 3200K directional tungsten keylight, WSJ consumer economics style, 8k documentary still, zero text overlays, no cartoons, no stickmen.
beats.motion_prompt: Slow smooth 35mm commercial dolly push-in toward the tall iced coffee cup on dark slate, hand gently lifting cup as ice cubes shift and settle with realistic fluid physics under warm directional keylight, locked geometry, zero morphing.
beats.narration: Cầm ly cà phê cỡ lớn năm mươi chín nghìn, bạn tưởng mình vừa chớp được món hời.

beats.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 tabletop photograph showing small and medium takeaway cups standing on dark slate beside a wooden café counter, warm amber lighting casting crisp cast shadows, commercial product photography, f/2.0 depth of field, zero text overlays, no cartoons, no stickmen.
beats.motion_prompt: Smooth eye-level lateral tabletop tracking pass from left to right, revealing the small cup and medium cup side by side under warm tungsten spotlight, steady specular reflections on polished counter, zero morphing.
beats.narration: Bảng giá quán niêm yết: cỡ nhỏ ba mươi chín nghìn và cỡ vừa năm mươi lăm nghìn đồng.

beats.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 macro shot of the narrow space between the medium cup and the tall large cup on slate surface, warm directional beam highlighting the four thousand dong price gap, tactile commercial cinematography, zero text overlays, no cartoons, no stickmen.
beats.motion_prompt: Slow optical rack-focus shifting from the medium cup to the tall large cup standing immediately beside it, amber liquid reflections catching keylight, crisp f/2.0 optical focus pull, zero morphing.
beats.narration: Khoảng cách giữa cỡ nhỏ và vừa tới mười sáu nghìn, nhưng lên cỡ lớn chỉ thêm bốn nghìn đồng.

beats.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 tabletop composition showing all three cup sizes aligned vertically on slate, small, medium, and large, illuminated by precision commercial rim lights, WSJ consumer economics style, f/2.0 depth of field, zero text overlays, no cartoons, no stickmen.
beats.motion_prompt: Smooth slow vertical tilt up along the height profile of the three cups, showing dramatic volume contrast from small to large under consistent 3200K studio keylight, rigid physical geometry, zero morphing.
beats.narration: Não bạn lập tức so sánh: bốn nghìn đồng quá rẻ để đổi lấy ly nước gấp rưỡi dung tích.

beats.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 documentary close-up of customer hand handing crisp polymer Vietnamese banknotes across wooden counter edge to cashier, warm café interior softly blurred, commercial still, zero text overlays, no cartoons, no stickmen.
beats.motion_prompt: Slow deliberate push-in as customer hand hands polymer banknotes across counter edge, smooth paper bend and weight transfer under warm tungsten spotlight, clean commercial color grading, zero morphing.
beats.narration: Bạn vui vẻ rút ví chọn ly lớn nhất vì tin rằng mình vừa tiết kiệm được tiền.

beats.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 shot of the medium cup standing completely isolated under a single sharp theatrical spotlight on dark slate table, casting long dark shadow, visual metaphor of sacrifice, f/2.0 depth of field, zero text overlays, no cartoons, no stickmen.
beats.motion_prompt: Slow dramatic camera orbit around the isolated medium cup on dark slate, single narrow tungsten beam casting rotating shadow, pristine tabletop textures, silent commercial cinematography, zero morphing.
beats.narration: Nhưng thực tế, ly cỡ vừa sinh ra trên thực đơn chưa từng được tạo ra để bán.

beats.narration: Chi phí sữa và siro thêm vào ly lớn thực chất tốn của quán chưa tới tám trăm đồng.

beats.prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 shot of an open artisan leather wallet on dark slate with two ten-thousand dong polymer banknotes being pulled out, warm tungsten side-light, f/2.0 depth of field, zero text overlays, no cartoons, no stickmen.

beats.narration: Quán đã khéo léo móc thêm từ túi bạn hai mươi nghìn đồng so với nhu cầu uống thật.
